admission.justification: Without the parent-first remedy a sender refused only because a recipient was archived or busy would be told to ask the developer in its own chat, which silently breaks the single top-chat chain the change exists to create; the remedy text is the only guidance a refused sender gets.

applicability: The nextAction remedy text of a role_message refusal that still leaves the message transportable.
conditions: The recipient-archived, scope-changed and resume/undelivered refusals name the parent with role_message first and the own chat only for an agent without one.
The refusal reason, its code and the delivery algorithm are unchanged.
exclusions: No-runtime and host-unreachable refusals, whose own-chat advice stays.
Transport behavior, refusal codes and any change to which tool calls a harness asks about.

evidence: Focused test_paseo_role_tools.py and test_paseo_role_messages.py; exact production diff; no runtime algorithm or refusal changes

statement: Role-message remedies that retain transport name the parent before the parentless own chat, while no-runtime and host-unreachable remedies retain their own-chat advice.
